lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Meridian Campus, 2148. What is left above ground is foundations. What is left below is this: a vault corridor with four inches of standing water in it, and a door at the far end that was sealed from the inside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Whoever sealed it did it in the year the Quiet started — the year the resistance lost and the counting stopped. They did it carefully, from the inside, and then took four days to get out the service way.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: Nobody in Ash Camp has ever been in here. We had stories about this corridor. Three or four of them. None of them had water in.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: The 2064 atrium was full of documents. Founding charters, board minutes, the instruments from the Handover. All of it came down here when the campus was abandoned, and all of it is behind that door, and nobody has opened it in a hundred and sixty years.
